name: bright-security
description: Bright DAST discovery, scanning, and remediation automation for Cursor using the Bright MCP server.

BRIGHT_HOSTNAME.title: Bright hostname
BRIGHT_HOSTNAME.description: Bright cluster hostname the MCP server and Repeater connect to (e.g. app.brightsec.com). Resolved from the shell environment so the local Bright CLI Repeater reads the same value.

BRIGHT_TOKEN.title: Bright API token
BRIGHT_TOKEN.description: Bright API token used by the MCP server and the Bright CLI Repeater. Provide it via the environment; never commit it.
